records.outcome: The court upheld the finding of family-status discrimination but varied some remedies, including how lost wages and employer-policy consultation were addressed.

records.title: Sidhu & Kopeck v. International Longshore and Warehouse Union Local 500

records.title: Molyneaux v. National Arts Centre Corporation
records.outcome: The complaint was dismissed. A disability alone does not automatically prove an adverse impact or a failure to accommodate.

records.title: Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration) v. Vavilov

records.title: Chopra v. Health Canada
records.outcome: The complaint was allowed in part. The Tribunal awarded $4,000 for hurt feelings plus lost wages and interest, and ordered no additional systemic measures.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été accueillie en partie. Le Tribunal a accordé 4 000 $ pour préjudice moral ainsi que les salaires perdus et les intérêts, sans ordonner d’autres mesures systémiques.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Temate v. Public Health Agency of Canada
records.outcome: The Tribunal refused to expand the complaint to retaliation, but held that alleged discriminatory exercises of management authority could count as harassment. No finding on discrimination has been made.
records.outcome_fr: Le Tribunal a refusé d’élargir la plainte aux représailles, mais a jugé que des mesures de gestion discriminatoires alléguées pouvaient constituer du harcèlement. Aucune conclusion sur la discrimination n’a été rendue.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Mohamed v. Royal Bank of Canada
records.outcome: The Tribunal dismissed the Bank’s motion to strike. The retaliation allegations stay within the scope of the case. No finding on discrimination has been made.
records.outcome_fr: Le Tribunal a rejeté la requête en radiation de la Banque. Les allégations de représailles demeurent dans la portée de l’affaire. Aucune conclusion sur la discrimination n’a été rendue.
records.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

records.title: MacDonald v. Canadian Armed Forces
records.outcome: The Tribunal dismissed the motion to add retaliation claims. The sex and disability complaints continue. No finding on discrimination has been made.
records.outcome_fr: Le Tribunal a rejeté la requête visant à ajouter les allégations de représailles. Les plaintes fondées sur le sexe et le handicap se poursuivent. Aucune conclusion sur la discrimination n’a été rendue.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: Benner v. Royal Canadian Mounted Police
records.outcome: The Tribunal denied the request to strike. The complaint continues. No finding on discrimination has been made.
records.outcome_fr: Le Tribunal a rejeté la demande de radiation. La plainte se poursuit. Aucune conclusion sur la discrimination n’a été rendue.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: Sangha v. Mackenzie Valley Land and Water Board
records.outcome: The complaint was allowed in part. The Tribunal awarded $9,500 for pain and suffering and ordered the employer to stop automatically rejecting overqualified applicants, but denied lost wages and reinstatement. The Federal Court later sent the damages question back to the Tribunal.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été accueillie en partie. Le Tribunal a accordé 9 500 $ pour préjudice moral et ordonné à l’employeur de cesser de rejeter automatiquement les candidats surqualifiés, mais a refusé les salaires perdus et la réintégration. La Cour fédérale a ensuite renvoyé la question des dommages au Tribunal.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: Mossop v. Canada (Secretary of State)
records.citation: Mossop v. Canada (Secretary of State), (1989) 10 CHRR D/6064
records.outcome: The Tribunal allowed the complaint and ordered the leave designated as bereavement leave plus $250 in damages. The Federal Court of Appeal set the decision aside, and the Supreme Court agreed (1993, 4 to 3) that family status did not cover same-sex relationships.
records.outcome_fr: Le Tribunal a accueilli la plainte et ordonné que le congé soit désigné comme congé de deuil, plus 250 $ en dommages. La Cour d’appel fédérale a annulé la décision, et la Cour suprême a confirmé (1993, 4 contre 3) que la situation de famille ne couvrait pas les relations de même sexe.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Reeves v. Deputy Head (Department of National Defence)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The grievance was allowed. The Board ordered reinstatement in the apprenticeship and $25,000 in compensation, with other remedies reserved.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été accueilli. La Commission a ordonné la réintégration dans le programme d’apprentissage et une indemnité de 25 000 $, les autres réparations étant réservées.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Paynter v. Deputy Head (Canada Border Services Agency)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The grievances were denied. The Board found no discrimination.
records.outcome_fr: Les griefs ont été rejetés. La Commission n’a constaté aucune discrimination.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Saifuddin v. Deputy Head (Department of Public Works and Government Services)
records.body: Public Service Labour Relations Board (FPSLREB predecessor)
records.outcome: The grievance was dismissed.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été rejeté.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Guilbault v. Treasury Board (Department of National Defence)
records.body: Public Service Labour Relations Board (FPSLREB predecessor)
records.outcome: The grievance was dismissed. Later help from the employer was a moral step, not a legal duty.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été rejeté. L’aide offerte plus tard par l’employeur était un geste moral, et non une obligation juridique.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Gueye v. Treasury Board (Canada Border Services Agency)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The grievance was denied.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été rejeté.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Matos v. Deputy Head (Canada Border Services Agency)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The grievance was dismissed, but the Federal Court of Appeal later sent the damages question back to a different Board member for a fresh decision.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été rejeté, mais la Cour d’appel fédérale a ensuite renvoyé la question des dommages-intérêts à un autre commissaire pour une nouvelle décision.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Babb v. Canada Revenue Agency
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The grievance was dismissed. The Federal Court of Appeal upheld that result in 2022 FCA 55.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été rejeté. La Cour d’appel fédérale a confirmé ce résultat dans 2022 CAF 55.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Casper v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The grievance was dismissed. The Federal Court of Appeal dismissed the judicial review in 2024.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été rejeté. La Cour d’appel fédérale a rejeté la demande de contrôle judiciaire en 2024.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Belisle v. Deputy Head (Department of Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development)
records.body: Public Service Labour Relations Board (FPSLREB predecessor)
records.outcome: The grievance was dismissed.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été rejeté.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Rahman v. Deputy Head (Department of Indian Affairs and Northern Development)
records.body: Public Service Labour Relations Board (FPSLREB predecessor)
records.outcome: The termination grievance was dismissed for lack of jurisdiction. The Federal Court upheld that result in 2013 FC 1007.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief de congédiement a été rejeté pour absence de compétence. La Cour fédérale a confirmé ce résultat dans 2013 CF 1007.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Rai v. Treasury Board (Royal Canadian Mounted Police)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The preliminary objection was dismissed. No finding on discrimination was made in this ruling.
records.outcome_fr: L’objection préliminaire a été rejetée. Aucune conclusion sur la discrimination n’a été tirée dans cette décision.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: Belovich v. Deputy Head (Department of National Defence)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The grievance was denied for lack of jurisdiction. No finding on the accommodation claim was made.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été rejeté pour absence de compétence. Aucune conclusion sur la demande d’adaptation n’a été tirée.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Raymond v. Deputy Head (Canada Border Services Agency)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The preliminary objection was dismissed and the hearing will continue. No finding on reprisal was made in this ruling.
records.outcome_fr: L’objection préliminaire a été rejetée et l’audience se poursuivra. Aucune conclusion sur les représailles n’a été tirée dans cette décision.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Cyr v. Treasury Board (Department of Human Resources and Skills Development)
records.body: Public Service Labour Relations Board (FPSLREB predecessor)
records.outcome: The grievance was allowed. The Board awarded $8,000 for pain and suffering, $10,000 in special compensation and $300 for a medical certificate, plus leave reimbursement.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été accueilli. La Commission a accordé 8 000 $ pour préjudice moral, 10 000 $ en indemnité spéciale et 300 $ pour un certificat médical, en plus du remboursement de congés.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Pham v. Treasury Board (Department of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Development)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The grievance was allowed. The Board awarded half the salary difference for the two-year posting, plus $10,000 for pain and suffering and $5,000 in special compensation.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été accueilli. La Commission a accordé la moitié de la différence salariale pour l’affectation de deux ans, plus 10 000 $ pour préjudice moral et 5 000 $ en indemnité spéciale.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Harrison and others v. National Research Council of Canada
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: Two grievances were upheld and three were dismissed. The decision applies the religious accommodation approach from Bedirian.
records.outcome_fr: Deux griefs ont été accueillis et trois ont été rejetés. La décision applique l’approche en matière d’adaptation religieuse établie dans Bedirian.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Ngueyo v. Deputy Head (Canada School of Public Service)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The staffing complaint was dismissed.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte de dotation a été rejetée.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Bois v. Deputy Head (Royal Canadian Mounted Police)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The staffing complaint was dismissed.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte de dotation a été rejetée.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: Complainant X v. Respondent Y
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: The objections were dismissed and the complaint will proceed to a hearing. No finding on the union’s conduct was made in this ruling.
records.outcome_fr: Les objections ont été rejetées et la plainte sera entendue. Aucune conclusion sur la conduite du syndicat n’a été tirée dans cette décision.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Central Alberta Dairy Pool v. Alberta (Human Rights Commission)
records.outcome: The complaint was upheld. The employer had to accommodate the employee’s religious observance unless it could show undue hardship.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été retenue. L’employeur devait accommoder l’observance religieuse de l’employé, sauf s’il pouvait démontrer une contrainte excessive.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Central Okanagan School District No. 23 v. Renaud
records.outcome: The complaint was upheld. The proposed shift was a reasonable accommodation, and the union’s objection did not excuse the failure to provide it.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été retenue. Le quart proposé était un accommodement raisonnable, et l’opposition du syndicat ne justifiait pas le refus de l’accorder.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: British Columbia (Superintendent of Motor Vehicles) v. British Columbia (Council of Human Rights)
records.outcome: The complaint was upheld. The blanket standard was discriminatory because it allowed no individual assessment or accommodation.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été retenue. La norme uniforme était discriminatoire parce qu’elle ne permettait aucune évaluation individuelle ni aucun accommodement.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Moore v. British Columbia (Education)
records.outcome: The complaint was upheld. The district had discriminated by failing to provide meaningful access to education, and the family was awarded compensation.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été retenue. Le district avait fait preuve de discrimination en ne donnant pas un accès réel à l’éducation, et la famille a reçu une indemnité.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Quebec (Commission des droits de la personne et des droits de la jeunesse) v. Bombardier Inc. (Bombardier Aerospace Training Center)
records.outcome: The claim failed. The evidence did not prove the training refusal was connected to the pilot’s ethnic origin, and the large damages award was set aside.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a échoué. La preuve n’a pas établi que le refus de formation était lié à l’origine ethnique du pilote, et l’importante indemnité accordée a été annulée.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Stewart v. Elk Valley Coal Corp.
records.outcome: The complaint was dismissed. The employer was entitled to enforce its safety policy, and the termination stood.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été rejetée. L’employeur pouvait appliquer sa politique de sécurité, et le congédiement a été maintenu.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: McGill University Health Centre (Montreal General Hospital) v. Syndicat des employés de l'Hôpital général de Montréal
records.outcome: The complaint was dismissed. The employer had met its duty, and the termination under the 36-month clause was upheld.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été rejetée. L’employeur avait respecté son obligation, et le congédiement en vertu de la clause de 36 mois a été maintenu.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Hydro-Québec v. Syndicat des employé-e-s de techniques professionnelles et de bureau d'Hydro-Québec, section locale 2000 (SCFP-FTQ)
records.outcome: The complaint was dismissed. The employer had done enough, and the dismissal was upheld.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été rejetée. L’employeur en avait fait assez, et le congédiement a été maintenu.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Janzen v. Platy Enterprises Ltd.
records.outcome: The complaints were upheld. Sexual harassment was recognized as sex discrimination, and the employer was liable.
records.outcome_fr: Les plaintes ont été retenues. Le harcèlement sexuel a été reconnu comme une discrimination fondée sur le sexe, et l’employeur a été tenu responsable.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Andrews v. Law Society of British Columbia
records.outcome: The challenge succeeded. The citizenship requirement was struck down as contrary to equality rights.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation a été accueillie. L’exigence de citoyenneté a été invalidée comme contraire aux droits à l’égalité.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Canada (Attorney General) v. Mossop
records.outcome: The complaint was dismissed. The Court held that the leave policy did not discriminate on the ground of family status.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été rejetée. La Cour a jugé que la politique de congé n’était pas discriminatoire au motif de la situation de famille.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Vriend v. Alberta
records.outcome: The challenge succeeded. Sexual orientation was read into Alberta’s human rights law, so gay and lesbian employees gained protection against discrimination.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation a été accueillie. L’orientation sexuelle a été ajoutée à la loi albertaine sur les droits de la personne, ce qui a donné aux employés gais et lesbiennes une protection contre la discrimination.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Egan v. Canada
records.outcome: The appeal was dismissed. The allowance was not payable, but the decision established sexual orientation as a protected ground under the Charter.
records.outcome_fr: L’appel a été rejeté. L’allocation n’était pas payable, mais la décision a établi l’orientation sexuelle comme motif protégé en vertu de la Charte.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Syndicat Northcrest v. Amselem
records.outcome: The challenge succeeded. The residents were allowed to build their sukkahs, subject to reasonable conditions.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation a été accueillie. Les résidents ont été autorisés à construire leurs souccahs, sous réserve de conditions raisonnables.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Multani v. Commission scolaire Marguerite-Bourgeoys
records.outcome: The challenge succeeded. The student was allowed to wear his kirpan under the agreed safety conditions.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation a été accueillie. L’élève a été autorisé à porter son kirpan selon les conditions de sécurité convenues.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Alberta v. Hutterian Brethren of Wilson Colony
records.outcome: The challenge failed. The photo requirement stood, and the exemption was not restored.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation a échoué. L’exigence de photo a été maintenue, et l’exemption n’a pas été rétablie.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Eldridge v. British Columbia (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The challenge succeeded. The province was required to provide sign language interpretation in public medical services.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation a été accueillie. La province a été tenue de fournir des services d’interprétation en langue des signes dans les services médicaux publics.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Council of Canadians with Disabilities v. VIA Rail Canada Inc.
records.outcome: The complaint was upheld. The order to make the cars accessible was confirmed.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été retenue. L’ordonnance exigeant de rendre les wagons accessibles a été confirmée.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Canada (Canadian Human Rights Commission) v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The costs award was set aside. The Tribunal has no power to order a party to pay another party’s legal costs.
records.outcome_fr: L’ordonnance de frais a été annulée. Le Tribunal n’a pas le pouvoir d’ordonner à une partie de payer les frais juridiques d’une autre partie.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: Northern Regional Health Authority v. Horrocks
records.outcome: The human rights complaint could not proceed. The dispute belonged in grievance arbitration, not before the human rights tribunal.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte en matière de droits de la personne ne pouvait pas être instruite. Le litige relevait de l’arbitrage de griefs, et non du tribunal des droits de la personne.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Weber v. Ontario Hydro
records.outcome: The court action was barred. The employee had to use the grievance and arbitration process.
records.outcome_fr: L’action en justice a été rejetée. L’employé devait utiliser le processus de grief et d’arbitrage.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Parry Sound (District) Social Services Administration Board v. O.P.S.E.U., Local 324
records.outcome: The grievance could proceed. The arbitrator had jurisdiction to decide whether the firing was discriminatory, despite the clause barring probationary grievances.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief pouvait être instruit. L’arbitre avait compétence pour décider si le congédiement était discriminatoire, malgré la clause interdisant les griefs en période probatoire.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Ross v. New Brunswick School District No. 15
records.outcome: The removal from the classroom was upheld, but the order to fire him if he kept publishing was struck down as too broad.
records.outcome_fr: Le retrait de la salle de classe a été maintenu, mais l’ordonnance de congédiement en cas de publication continue a été annulée comme étant trop large.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Slaight Communications Inc. v. Davidson
records.outcome: The remedy was largely upheld. The employer’s challenge failed, and the reference letter order stood.
records.outcome_fr: Le recours a été largement maintenu. La contestation de l’employeur a échoué, et l’ordonnance relative à la lettre de référence est demeurée en vigueur.
records.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

records.title: Dunsmuir v. New Brunswick
records.outcome: The dismissal was found unreasonable, and the decision was set aside. The two-standard framework later gave way to the Vavilov framework, which is already in this library.
records.outcome_fr: Le congédiement a été jugé déraisonnable, et la décision a été annulée. Le cadre à deux normes a ensuite été remplacé par le cadre de l’arrêt Vavilov, déjà présent dans cette bibliothèque.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Baker v. Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration)
records.outcome: The decision was set aside and sent back for reconsideration. The case remains the leading authority on procedural fairness.
records.outcome_fr: La décision a été annulée et renvoyée pour réexamen. L’affaire demeure l’autorité de référence en matière d’équité procédurale.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Newfoundland and Labrador Nurses' Union v. Newfoundland and Labrador (Treasury Board)
records.outcome: The challenge failed. The board’s decision was upheld.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation a échoué. La décision de la commission a été maintenue.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Association of Justice Counsel v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The grievance succeeded in part. The directive breached the collective agreement, but it did not violate the lawyers’ liberty under section 7 of the Charter.
records.outcome_fr: Le grief a été accueilli en partie. La directive violait la convention collective, mais elle ne portait pas atteinte à la liberté des avocats au titre de l’article 7 de la Charte.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: R. v. Kapp
records.outcome: The challenge failed. The communal fishing opening was a protected ameliorative program, not discrimination.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation a échoué. L’ouverture de pêche communautaire était un programme d’amélioration protégé, et non de la discrimination.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Kahkewistahaw First Nation v. Taypotat
records.outcome: The challenge failed. The evidence did not prove the education requirement had a disproportionate impact on older First Nation members.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation a échoué. La preuve n’a pas établi que l’exigence de scolarité avait un effet disproportionné sur les membres plus âgés de la Première Nation.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: British Columbia Human Rights Tribunal v. Schrenk
records.outcome: The complaint could proceed. The tribunal had jurisdiction over the remarks, and the case was sent back for a hearing on the merits.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte pouvait être instruite. Le tribunal avait compétence sur les propos, et l’affaire a été renvoyée pour une audience sur le fond.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: B. v. Ontario (Human Rights Commission)
records.outcome: The complaint was upheld. The firing was discrimination based on family status.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été retenue. Le congédiement était une discrimination fondée sur la situation de famille.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Communications, Energy and Paperworkers Union of Canada, Local 30 v. Irving Pulp & Paper, Ltd.
records.outcome: The union’s challenge succeeded. The random testing policy was struck down as unreasonable.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation du syndicat a été accueillie. La politique de tests aléatoires a été annulée comme déraisonnable.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Wilson v. Atomic Energy of Canada Ltd.
records.outcome: The complaint was upheld. The dismissal was unjust, and the case was sent back to decide the remedy.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été retenue. Le congédiement était injuste, et l’affaire a été renvoyée pour déterminer le recours.
records.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

records.title: Honda Canada Inc. v. Keays
records.outcome: The appeal succeeded in part. The notice period was reduced to 15 months, and the aggravated and punitive damages were set aside.
records.outcome_fr: L’appel a été accueilli en partie. La période de préavis a été réduite à 15 mois, et les dommages-intérêts majorés et punitifs ont été annulés.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: British Columbia (Attorney General) v. Council of Canadians with Disabilities
records.outcome: The organization was granted public interest standing. The constitutional challenge could proceed.
records.outcome_fr: L’organisation a obtenu la qualité pour agir dans l’intérêt public. La contestation constitutionnelle pouvait être instruite.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Canada (Canadian Human Rights Commission) v. Canada (Attorney General) (Matson and Andrews)
records.outcome: The complaints could not proceed under the human rights legislation. The families had to bring a Charter challenge instead.
records.outcome_fr: Les plaintes ne pouvaient pas être instruites en vertu de la loi sur les droits de la personne. Les familles devaient plutôt présenter une contestation fondée sur la Charte.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Seneca College of Applied Arts and Technology v. Bhadauria
records.outcome: The lawsuit was dismissed. A discrimination claim in hiring must be brought under the human rights statute, not as a civil action.
records.outcome_fr: La poursuite a été rejetée. Une plainte de discrimination en embauche doit être présentée en vertu de la loi sur les droits de la personne, et non comme une action civile.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Canada (Attorney General) v. First Nations Child and Family Caring Society of Canada
records.outcome: Canada’s application for judicial review was dismissed. The compensation order stood.
records.outcome_fr: La demande de contrôle judiciaire du Canada a été rejetée. L’ordonnance d’indemnisation est demeurée en vigueur.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: Chopra v. Canada (Attorney General) (Commission screening)
records.outcome: The judicial review was allowed. The complaint was sent back to the Commission for reconsideration.
records.outcome_fr: Le contrôle judiciaire a été accueilli. La plainte a été renvoyée à la Commission pour réexamen.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Chopra v. Canada (Attorney General) (Tribunal remedy)
records.outcome: The appeal was dismissed. The finding of discrimination stood, but no further compensation or appointment was ordered.
records.outcome_fr: L’appel a été rejeté. La conclusion de discrimination est demeurée, mais aucune indemnité supplémentaire ni nomination n’a été ordonnée.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Baragar v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The complaint was dismissed. The staffing decision stood.
records.outcome_fr: La plainte a été rejetée. La décision de dotation est demeurée en vigueur.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Matos v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The judicial review was allowed. The board’s decision was set aside, and the question of pain and suffering damages was sent to a different board member.
records.outcome_fr: Le contrôle judiciaire a été accueilli. La décision de la commission a été annulée, et la question des dommages-intérêts pour souffrances morales a été renvoyée à un autre commissaire.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Boulachanis v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: An interlocutory injunction was granted. The transfer could proceed while the case continued.
records.outcome_fr: Une injonction interlocutoire a été accordée. Le transfert pouvait avoir lieu pendant que l’affaire se poursuivait.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: Parkdale Community Legal Services v. Canada
records.outcome: The challenge was dismissed. The $20,000 limits remain in force.
records.outcome_fr: La contestation a été rejetée. Les plafonds de 20 000 $ demeurent en vigueur.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: Seck v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The application for judicial review was dismissed. The Federal Court of Appeal later affirmed the dismissal and set out the test for fraud under the Act.
records.outcome_fr: La demande de contrôle judiciaire a été rejetée. La Cour d’appel fédérale a ensuite confirmé le rejet et énoncé le critère de la fraude selon la Loi.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: MacAdam v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The applications for judicial review were dismissed. The Commission finding of improper conduct and the revocation of the appointment stood.
records.outcome_fr: Les demandes de contrôle judiciaire ont été rejetées. La conclusion de conduite irrégulière et la révocation de la nomination ont été maintenues.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Public Service Commission investigation: false academic credentials (File No. 18-19-03)
records.citation: PSC Investigation Summary, File No. 18-19-03 (PSEA s. 69)
records.outcome: The Commission found fraud, revoked the appointment, and barred the person from federal public service employment for three years without its written approval.
records.outcome_fr: La Commission a conclu à la fraude, a révoqué la nomination et a interdit à la personne d’occuper un emploi dans la fonction publique fédérale pendant trois ans sans son approbation écrite.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Public Service Commission investigation: political activity on a personal Twitter account (File No. 20-21-08)
records.citation: PSC Investigation Summary, File No. 20-21-08 (PSEA s. 113)
records.outcome: The Commission found a breach of the political activities rules and ordered an individual awareness session, warning that failure to attend would lead to dismissal.
records.outcome_fr: La Commission a conclu à une violation des règles sur les activités politiques et a ordonné une séance de sensibilisation individuelle, en avertissant que l’absence entraînerait le congédiement.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Public Service Commission investigation: candidacy in the 2021 federal election without permission (File No. 22-23-02)
records.citation: PSC Investigation Summary, File No. 22-23-02 (PSEA s. 114)
records.outcome: The Commission found the employee failed to comply with the candidacy rules and ordered an awareness session, warning that failure to attend would lead to dismissal.
records.outcome_fr: La Commission a conclu que l’employé n’avait pas respecté les règles sur les candidatures et a ordonné une séance de sensibilisation, en avertissant que l’absence entraînerait le congédiement.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Osborne v. Canada (Treasury Board)
records.outcome: The Court struck down the ban for ordinary employees. It kept the ban only for deputy heads. The current Act now allows political activity that does not impair impartiality.
records.outcome_fr: La Cour a invalidé l’interdiction pour les employés ordinaires. Elle ne l’a maintenue que pour les sous-ministres. La loi actuelle permet les activités politiques qui ne nuisent pas à l’impartialité.
records.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

records.title: Public Sector Integrity Commissioner case report: Canadian Food Inspection Agency (February 2017)
records.citation: PSIC Case Report, Canadian Food Inspection Agency (February 2017)
records.body: Office of the Public Sector Integrity Commissioner
records.outcome: The Commissioner found gross mismanagement, a form of wrongdoing, and made recommendations to the Agency chief executive. The report was tabled in Parliament.
records.outcome_fr: Le commissaire a conclu à une mauvaise gestion flagrante, une forme d’acte répréhensible, et a formulé des recommandations au premier dirigeant de l’Agence. Le rapport a été déposé au Parlement.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Public Sector Integrity Commissioner case report: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (June 2017)
records.citation: PSIC Case Report, Fisheries and Oceans Canada (June 2017)
records.body: Office of the Public Sector Integrity Commissioner
records.outcome: The Commissioner found wrongdoing, made recommendations to the chief executive, and tabled the report in Parliament.
records.outcome_fr: Le commissaire a conclu à un acte répréhensible, a formulé des recommandations au premier dirigeant et a déposé le rapport au Parlement.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Biles v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The Federal Court dismissed the judicial review. The Commissioner decision not to refer the complaint to the Tribunal stood.
records.outcome_fr: La Cour fédérale a rejeté la demande de contrôle judiciaire. La décision du commissaire de ne pas renvoyer la plainte au Tribunal a été maintenue.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: El-Helou v. Courts Administration Service
records.outcome: The court allowed the review in part and quashed the decision on the referred complaint. The Tribunal had to decide that complaint, and the dismissal of the other complaints stood.
records.outcome_fr: La cour a accueilli en partie la demande et a annulé la décision sur la plainte renvoyée. Le Tribunal devait trancher cette plainte, et le rejet des autres plaintes a été maintenu.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Agnaou v. Public Prosecution Service of Canada
records.citation: Public Servants Disclosure Protection Tribunal, File T-2017-01 (13 November 2019); upheld 2022 FCA 140
records.outcome: The Tribunal dismissed the complaint. The Federal Court of Appeal dismissed the appeal in 2022, and the Supreme Court refused leave to appeal in 2023.
records.outcome_fr: Le Tribunal a rejeté la plainte. La Cour d’appel fédérale a rejeté l’appel en 2022, et la Cour suprême a refusé l’autorisation d’appel en 2023.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Public Service Alliance of Canada v. Bank of Canada
records.outcome: The Commissioner held the employer could not cap the number of union representatives, but dismissed the bad faith complaint because the employer had a reasoned position and no ill will.
records.outcome_fr: La commissaire a jugé que l’employeur ne pouvait pas limiter le nombre de représentants syndicaux, mais a rejeté la plainte de mauvaise foi parce que l’employeur avait une position motivée et aucune malveillance.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: United Steelworkers v. Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce
records.outcome: The Commissioner agreed with the employer that the Act did not apply to that dispute. The decision set an early limit on what can be raised as a matter in dispute.
records.outcome_fr: La commissaire a convenu avec l’employeur que la Loi ne s’appliquait pas à ce différend. La décision a fixé une première limite à ce qui peut être soulevé comme différend.
records.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

records.title: VIA Rail Canada Inc. v. Mulhern and Unifor
records.body: Occupational Health and Safety Tribunal Canada (Appeals Officer)
records.outcome: The appeals officer rescinded both directions and dismissed the second appeal for lack of jurisdiction. The case shows a danger finding for harassment is hard to sustain on appeal.
records.outcome_fr: L’agent d’appel a annulé les deux directives et a rejeté le deuxième appel pour défaut de compétence. L’affaire montre qu’une conclusion de danger fondée sur le harcèlement est difficile à maintenir en appel.
records.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

records.title: Canadian Food Inspection Agency v. Public Service Alliance of Canada
records.body: Occupational Health and Safety Tribunal Canada (Appeals Officer)
records.outcome: The appeals officer confirmed the direction. The employer had to appoint a competent person to investigate the complaint.
records.outcome_fr: L’agent d’appel a confirmé la directive. L’employeur devait nommer une personne compétente pour enquêter sur la plainte.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Natural Resources Canada v. Professional Institute of the Public Service of Canada
records.body: Occupational Health and Safety Tribunal Canada (Appeals Officer)
records.outcome: The appeals officer varied the direction. The employer still had to have the complaint investigated by a competent person.
records.outcome_fr: L’agent d’appel a modifié la directive. L’employeur devait tout de même faire enquêter sur la plainte par une personne compétente.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Canadian National Railway Company v. United Steelworkers
records.body: Occupational Health and Safety Tribunal Canada (Appeals Officer)
records.outcome: The appeals officer confirmed the direction. The employer had to produce a list of potential investigators from outside the organization.
records.outcome_fr: L’agent d’appel a confirmé la directive. L’employeur devait fournir une liste d’enquêteurs potentiels de l’extérieur de l’organisation.
records.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

records.title: Tryggvason v. Transport Canada
records.body: Occupational Health and Safety Tribunal Canada (Appeals Officer)
records.outcome: The appeals officer confirmed the no-danger decision. The refusal to work could not continue on that basis.
records.outcome_fr: L’agent d’appel a confirmé la décision d’absence de danger. Le refus de travailler ne pouvait pas se poursuivre pour ce motif.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Ayangma v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The Federal Court and the Federal Court of Appeal dismissed the judicial review. The Commission screening decision stood, and the Supreme Court refused leave to appeal.
records.outcome_fr: La Cour fédérale et la Cour d’appel fédérale ont rejeté le contrôle judiciaire. La décision de tri de la Commission a été maintenue, et la Cour suprême a refusé l’autorisation d’appel.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Belisle v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The court granted the judicial review and sent the matter back for redetermination. The investigation was not shown to be thorough, so the dismissal could not stand.
records.outcome_fr: La cour a accueilli le contrôle judiciaire et a renvoyé l’affaire pour nouvelle décision. L’enquête ne s’est pas révélée approfondie, donc le rejet ne pouvait pas être maintenu.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Ritchie v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The Federal Court dismissed the judicial review and the Federal Court of Appeal dismissed the appeal. The Commission decision not to refer the complaint stood.
records.outcome_fr: La Cour fédérale a rejeté le contrôle judiciaire et la Cour d’appel fédérale a rejeté l’appel. La décision de la Commission de ne pas renvoyer la plainte a été maintenue.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

records.title: CHRC horizontal audit: the employment of racialized people in management and executive positions (2025)
records.citation: CHRC, Horizontal Audit in the Public Service: The Employment of Racialized People in Management and Executive Positions (Sector-wide report, March 2025)
records.outcome: Only 2 of the 18 audited employers met the audit requirements. The audit found selection processes, unconscious bias in hiring, and workplace culture were the most common barriers.
records.outcome_fr: Seuls 2 des 18 employeurs vérifiés satisfaisaient aux exigences de la vérification. La vérification a révélé que les processus de sélection, les préjugés inconscients à l’embauche et la culture du milieu de travail étaient les obstacles les plus fréquents.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Kaseke v. Toronto Dominion Bank
records.body: Federal Court of Appeal (reviewing Canada Industrial Relations Board)
records.outcome: The Board declined to hear the complaint and the court agreed. The Human Rights Commission has primary jurisdiction, and the Board can act only if the Commission refers the matter back.
records.outcome_fr: Le Conseil a refusé d’entendre la plainte et la cour a été d’accord. La Commission des droits de la personne détient la compétence principale, et le Conseil ne peut agir que si la Commission lui renvoie l’affaire.
records.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

records.title: A.B. v. Treasury Board (Department of Industry)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: Grievance allowed. The Board ordered telework for at least two years from the date of the order; permanent telework was not granted. It ordered back pay from May 29, 2024 and the restoration of 65 hours of sick leave. It awarded $18,000 for pain and suffering and $10,000 for reckless conduct, totalling $28,000 in human rights damages, separate from back pay. No interest was awarded. Uninsured therapy and medication costs were not reimbursed because their value was not established by evidence.
records.outcome_fr: Grief accueilli. La Commission a ordonné le télétravail pendant au moins deux ans à compter de la date de l’ordonnance; le télétravail permanent n’a pas été accordé. Elle a ordonné le versement du salaire rétroactif à compter du 29 mai 2024 et le rétablissement de 65 heures de congé de maladie. Elle a accordé 18 000 $ pour préjudice moral et 10 000 $ pour conduite téméraire, soit 28 000 $ en dommages-intérêts liés aux droits de la personne, en plus du salaire rétroactif. Aucun intérêt n’a été accordé. Les frais de thérapie et de médicaments non assurés n’ont pas été remboursés, faute de preuve de leur valeur.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public-service or institution decision

records.title: Parkes v. Deputy Head (Department of Citizenship and Immigration)
records.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
records.outcome: Staffing complaint dismissed. This ruling does not declare that systemic discrimination is absent at IRCC or elsewhere; it concerns the evidence and specific appointment under review.
records.outcome_fr: Plainte de dotation rejetée. Cette décision ne conclut pas à l'absence de discrimination systémique à IRCC ou ailleurs; elle porte sur les faits et la nomination examinés.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public-service or institution decision

records.title: Mukbil v. Canada Border Services Agency
records.outcome: Human-rights complaint dismissed. Staffing irregularities and workplace inequity indicators, without evidence connecting them to the particular adverse decision, did not establish this complaint.
records.outcome_fr: Plainte en droits de la personne rejetée. Des irrégularités de dotation et des indicateurs d'iniquité ne suffisaient pas, sans preuve de lien avec la décision défavorable précise.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public-service or institution decision

records.title: Canada (Attorney General) v. Shakov
records.outcome: The Federal Court of Appeal allowed the appeal in part and remitted the investigation to the PSC. The earlier PSC remedies, including appointment revocation, had been set aside; this was not a general ruling permitting arbitrary language requirements.
records.outcome_fr: La Cour d'appel fédérale a accueilli l'appel en partie et renvoyé l'enquête à la CFP. Les anciennes mesures, dont la révocation de la nomination, avaient été annulées. La décision ne permet pas d'imposer arbitrairement des exigences linguistiques.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public-service or institution decision

records.title: Qi v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: Judicial review succeeded; the Federal Court ordered a new investigation. This was a procedural-fairness ruling, not a judicial determination that every underlying allegation of harassment was established.
records.outcome_fr: Contrôle judiciaire accueilli et nouvelle enquête ordonnée. La Cour n'a pas établi le bien-fondé de toutes les allégations de harcèlement.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public-service or institution decision

records.title: Carreau v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: Judicial review was dismissed. The Court did not require the finalized report to be reopened for additional argument; failure or delay by senior management can be relevant to workplace harassment.
records.outcome_fr: Contrôle judiciaire rejeté. La Cour n'a pas exigé de rouvrir le rapport définitif; l'inaction ou les retards de la haute direction peuvent être pertinents au harcèlement.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public-service or institution decision

records.title: Commissioner of Official Languages: Public Safety Canada language-of-work and intimidation investigation
records.body: Office of the Commissioner of Official Languages
records.outcome: The complaint was founded. The Commissioner recommended management reminders about language-of-work obligations and employees' right to complain. This is an administrative investigation result, not a damages award.
records.outcome_fr: Plainte fondée. Le commissaire a recommandé un rappel aux gestionnaires sur les droits linguistiques et le droit de porter plainte. Il s'agit d'une enquête administrative, non d'une indemnité judiciaire.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public-service or institution decision

records.title: Commissioner of Official Languages: National Defence engineering position linguistic requirements
records.body: Office of the Commissioner of Official Languages
records.outcome: Complaints founded. The Commissioner recommended changing the position designation to bilingual CBC/CBC and temporary measures to support both official languages in performing its duties. This is an investigation, not appointment revocation.
records.outcome_fr: Plaintes fondées. Le commissaire a recommandé de désigner le poste bilingue CBC/CBC et d'adopter des mesures temporaires pour assurer le travail dans les deux langues officielles. Il ne s'agit pas d'une révocation de nomination.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public-service or institution decision

records.title: Commissioner of Official Languages: National Joint Council travel terminology
records.body: Office of the Commissioner of Official Languages
records.outcome: Complaint found unfounded. The Commissioner nevertheless encouraged Canadian French terminology, which was subsequently adopted. Not a discrimination merits decision.
records.outcome_fr: Plainte non fondée. Le commissaire a toutefois encouragé l'adoption des termes courants au Canada, qui ont ensuite été utilisés. Ce n'est pas un jugement de discrimination.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public-service or institution decision

records.title: RCMP External Review Committee: harassment appeal involving official bilingualism
records.outcome: The Committee recommended allowing the appeal and remitting the issue for redetermination. A recommendation is not the final RCMP adjudicator's decision and is not an award of damages.
records.outcome_fr: Le Comité a recommandé d'accueillir l'appel et de renvoyer le dossier pour une nouvelle décision. Il ne s'agit pas de la décision finale de la GRC ni d'une indemnité.
records.appliesTo: Federal public-sector review route; confirm employer-specific legislation

records.title: Marentette v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: Judicial review allowed; a new investigation with a different investigator was ordered. The ruling established a procedural-fairness violation, not that the underlying discrimination allegations were proven.
records.outcome_fr: Contrôle judiciaire accueilli; nouvelle enquête ordonnée avec un autre enquêteur. La décision constate un vice de procédure, sans établir les allégations sous-jacentes de discrimination.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

records.title: Brown v. Canada (Attorney General)
records.outcome: The Court ordered the matter reinvestigated from the point where procedural fairness was breached, preserving earlier investigation work. Later decisions, including Qi, distinguish this fact-specific remedy; no merits finding of harassment or discrimination should be inferred.
records.outcome_fr: La Cour a ordonné la reprise de l’enquête à partir du moment où l’équité procédurale avait été compromise, préservant les étapes antérieures. Des décisions ultérieures, dont Qi, distinguent cette réparation propre aux faits; aucune conclusion sur le fond du harcèlement ou de la discrimination n’en découle.
records.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case
